The build process consists of unpacking the `.deb` archive (via `ar` and `bsdtar`) and creating a wrapper script in `/usr/bin` to launch the application. It also renames icon files for consistency and installs a desktop entry with standard fields. All operations are confined to the package directory and follow standard packaging practices for repackaging a binary distribution for Arch Linux.

There are no network requests during build or install beyond the initial download of the source, no use of `eval`, `curl|bash`, or obfuscated code, and no suspicious file operations outside the package tree. While the use of a prebuilt binary prevents source-level auditing, the operations performed by the PKGBUILD itself are transparent and safe.
